dog.description_text: Meet Tito, a lovable boy with a goofy personality that's sure to keep you smiling! Tito has a playful spirit, a curious mind, and a big love for treats, making every day with him a fun adventure. Whether he's chasing a toy or showing off his silly side, Tito knows how to bring joy wherever he goes! One of Tito's favorite pastimes is people watching. He's always interested in what's going on around him and loves taking in the sights before jumping back into playtime. His curiosity and happy attitude make him an entertaining and wonderful companion. If you're looking for a fun loving dog who enjoys play, is eager to learn for a tasty treat, and will make you laugh with his goofy personality, Tito is ready to become your new best friend! Click “Adopt Me” to learn more about him! *You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: TITO
